classes.definition: A directly comparable signal or guard state is aligned across shadow and production/legacy surfaces within the same semantic domain.
classes.name: EXACT_AGREEMENT

classes.definition: For the same directly comparable safety trigger, the shadow surface emits an explicit caution/restriction while the production/legacy comparable surface emits no guard or allow-with-context.
classes.name: SHADOW_MORE_CAUTIOUS

classes.definition: For the same directly comparable safety trigger, the production/legacy surface emits an explicit caution/restriction while the shadow comparable signal does not establish caution.
classes.name: LEGACY_MORE_CAUTIOUS

classes.definition: The governed shadow path preserves UNKNOWN because authority or context is insufficient while a legacy/canonical surface still returns a decision from its own inputs.
classes.name: SHADOW_UNKNOWN_LEGACY_DECIDED

classes.definition: The shadow path returns a categorical decision while the selected legacy/canonical comparable surface is unable to decide from its own evidence.
classes.name: SHADOW_DECIDED_LEGACY_UNKNOWN

classes.definition: The production/legacy observation depends on heuristic ingredient-signal count/strength or another legacy-only construct that is not governed non-numeric PDA authority.
classes.name: LEGACY_HEURISTIC_DEPENDENCY

classes.definition: Divergence is caused by missing, blocked, or incomplete governed PDA/context authority that the shadow path must preserve explicitly.
classes.name: AUTHORITY_COVERAGE_GAP

classes.definition: Divergence is attributable to routine, sensitivity, reaction, recent-change, or window context external to the intrinsic PDA.
classes.name: ROUTINE_USER_CONTEXT_DIVERGENCE

classes.definition: The compared outputs belong to different semantic domains and no valid one-to-one interpretation exists.
classes.name: INCOMPARABLE_SEMANTICS

classification_model.rule: Classify the causal semantic relationship, never infer superiority from divergence.

comparison_surfaces.role: legacy functional axes, count-derived strength, caution tags
routine burden, treatment windows, duplicate-axis burden
